verdict.rationale: Postmark documents several multi-item endpoints: `/email/batch`, `/email/batchWithTemplates`, and `/email/bulk` for broadcast streams. Its llms.txt adds a TypeScript batch example that reports a `MessageID` or error per recipient, and templates can be pushed in bulk to another server. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond sending (e.g. mass bounce reactivation or bulk message/template management), documented batch size limits and partial-failure semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
